meta.title: Attentive: book a psychologist
meta.description: Find a psychologist and book a session online or in person, without waiting on WhatsApp.

home.title: Find someone you can actually talk to.
home.lede: {count, plural, =0 {Our psychologists} one {# psychologist} other {# psychologists}} in Jakarta, BSD and Malang, or online from wherever you are. Pick a time that suits you and it is booked straight away.
home.step1: Choose who the sessions are for, how you'd like to meet and where. Every psychologist shows their next open time.
home.step2: Open times are live, so what you see is what you get. Your booking is confirmed straight away.
home.step3: We email a reminder the day before and two hours before. Plans change? Move or cancel it yourself.
home.privacy: What you talk about stays between you and your psychologist. We only keep your booking details.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: We keep only what is needed to arrange your sessions: your name, contact details and your booking times.
privacy.p2: We never store what you talk about with your psychologist, and our emails never mention why you are seeing one.
privacy.p3: Check-in emails are sent only if you agree to them, and you can stop them at any time.

urgent.title: Need support sooner?
urgent.subtitle: Request an urgent psychology session in just a few steps. No account required.
urgent.name: Full Name
urgent.phoneHint: Enter your number without the country code. Indonesia (+62) is selected by default.
urgent.warning: Urgent scheduling is an appointment request, not an emergency response service. If you are in immediate danger, experiencing a life-threatening emergency, or at risk of harming yourself or someone else, please contact local emergency services or visit the nearest emergency department.
urgent.acknowledgement: I understand that urgent scheduling does not guarantee immediate assistance.
urgent.onlineSubtitle: We're here when you need us.
urgent.onsiteSubtitle: Thank you for reaching out to Attentive.
urgent.addressPending: The team will confirm the address and directions when arranging your visit.

Hi Attentive! I would like to request an urgent online psychology session.

My Booking Code is: {code}

My name is: {name}.

I would like to arrange the earliest available session.

Thank you!
